rules: SPC accepts Founder Fellowship applications twice a year. Fall 2026 closed on August 2; Spring 2027 opens later this year.

Fall 2026 terms: $400,000 upfront for 7% on a standard SAFE, plus $600,000 guaranteed in your next external funding round, and up to $1,000,000 in credits from companies including Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, GCP and AWS.
Fellows are funded the day they sign investment terms, then join an eight-week in-person bootcamp in a small cohort, followed by a residency with no fixed end date.
Fellows work from SPC's offices in San Francisco, New York City or Bangalore during the bootcamp.
You do not need an idea, but you must show how you generate ideas. Solo founders can apply; SPC prefers solo applicants who can build and prototype.
No industry restriction; the requirement is the ambition to build at the frontier.
Founders not ready for funding can apply to the Member Residency: six months, no cost and no equity.
SPC aims to make application decisions within a month.
